label: verify-t4-glide-data

claims.claim: Public repo per-trial data and stored model files are obtainable and byte-stable (hashes match earlier agents' downloads).
claims.note: I re-downloaded two files fresh from raw.githubusercontent.com and both hashes match the listed ones; the comparison with earlier agents' own quoted hashes was not independently seen.

claims.claim: Control U = 0.0676 m/s and psi=0 KL2.31 over control = 1.495 (1.395 in the second series).
claims.source_says: U=0.0676 f=0.612; [5] ratio ... (all_results_experiments): 1.495; [6] ratio psi0 KL2.31 (dict_all_results, rc=26) / control: 1.395
claims.note: Output file shows these, and 0.0944/0.0676 = 1.396 reproduces the second ratio to rounding; I did not re-run the analysis script.

claims.claim: Frozen BEM table reproduces from the saved port: psi=15 min Re 4352 at KL 1.805, port within 0.17 percent, pitch ratios 0.637 and 1.505.
claims.note: All numbers appear in the saved output; I read the output and did not re-run it, and the port is the agent's own code.

claims.claim: Two psi=0 series differ by about 7 percent at same geometry, similar to the 6.5 percent BEM-vs-disk separation at psi=15, so psi=15 discrimination rests on the psi=0 arm and pitch axis.
claims.source_says: [5] ratio ... 1.495; [6] ... 1.395. (No psi=15 disk-rule value in the output file.)
claims.note: The 7 percent holds (1.495/1.395 = 1.072), but the 1.183 psi=15 disk figure comes from a design file not in the cited source, and the 'rests on' conclusion is a judgment.

overall: Claims 1 to 3 hold. The saved output matches them and the two files I re-downloaded match the stated hashes. I did not re-run the analysis script. Claim 4's 7 percent figure checks out, but its 6.5 percent comparison and conclusion rest on a design file I did not check.
